questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "The Honest Farmer".
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a silent h, so it starts with a vowel sound: 'an honest'.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "The Honest Farmer".
questions.explanation: A purse is mentioned for the first time and starts with a consonant sound: 'a purse'.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (3) in the passage "The Honest Farmer".
questions.explanation: 'Identity' begins with a vowel sound /aɪ/, so 'an' is used.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (4) in the passage "The Honest Farmer".
questions.explanation: 'University' begins with the consonant sound /j/, so 'a university lecturer'.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "The Honest Farmer".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "Priya Moves to Bengaluru".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "Priya Moves to Bengaluru".
questions.explanation: 'Since March' with an ongoing action needs the present perfect continuous.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (3) in the passage "Priya Moves to Bengaluru".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (4) in the passage "Priya Moves to Bengaluru".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "Priya Moves to Bengaluru".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "The ISRO Team".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "The ISRO Team".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (3) in the passage "The ISRO Team".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (4) in the passage "The ISRO Team".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "The ISRO Team".
questions.explanation: 'Two-thirds of the budget' takes a singular verb because 'budget' is a singular noun; 'has already been spent'.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "A Morning by the Cauvery".
questions.explanation: 'Born in' a village is the standard collocation.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "A Morning by the Cauvery".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (3) in the passage "A Morning by the Cauvery".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (4) in the passage "A Morning by the Cauvery".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "A Morning by the Cauvery".
questions.explanation: 'Look forward to' always takes 'to', followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "Cousins in the Same Lane".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "Cousins in the Same Lane".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (4) in the passage "Cousins in the Same Lane".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "Cousins in the Same Lane".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "The Old Bridge".

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (2) in the passage "The Old Bridge".
